title: Writer Assistant Core candidate storage read/write contract and candidate-only persistence
goal: Define and implement candidate-only JSON persistence for typed Writer Assistant Core candidate records with validation-before-write and path safety before extraction runtime, routes, UI, model calls, apply-promotion, or memory/canon mutation exists.
why_now: PHASE8-IMPL-002 completed pure candidate record validation helpers and pure storage path helpers with no file I/O. The next safe slice is candidate-only persistence contracts and tests before runtime extraction, routes, UI, or model behavior expand.

include: Side-effect expectations for project-local candidate files only.
Candidate index behavior decision and tests, if authorized.
Candidate-only separation from OMI MVP, memory, canon, bible, storyform, scenes, notes, and materials.
exclude: Generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, or prose improvement.
Semantic search and Story Check auto-runs.
Apply-promotion, OMI candidate promotion, and memory/canon mutation.
Training data, JSONL records, dataset artifacts, and project runtime files.

safety_notes: No generated prose, rewriting, continuation, style imitation, prose improvement, or summaries as durable truth.
Persistence existence does not prove story truth.
Candidate persistence supports review only and does not approve or promote candidates.
OMI remains the central review and future promotion layer.
Promotion records remain audit-only until future apply-promotion exists.
Memory/canon mutation is out of scope.
Persistence helpers must not mutate bible, storyform, scenes, notes, materials, or approved memory/canon.
